rows.Control Title: Joiner-mover-leaver for core and network IDs
rows.Control Description: New core-banking, FedLine, and Active Directory IDs are requested through the access ticket, approved by the employee's manager and the application owner, and provisioned by IT Operations. Movers are recertified within five business days of the role change. Leavers are disabled the same day HR marks the last day.

rows.Control Title: Quarterly recertification of privileged core IDs
rows.Control Description: Application owners recertify every privileged ID on the core, SWIFT gateway, and domain admin groups each calendar quarter. IDs not recertified by the due date are disabled by IT Operations the next business day.

rows.Control Title: Segregation of duties: note origination vs GL posting
rows.Control Description: No user may both originate a commercial note in the core and post the related general-ledger entry. The SOD matrix is reviewed when roles change and at least annually. Exceptions require CFO written approval and a compensating review.

rows.Control Title: Privileged access on FedLine and core is named and logged
rows.Control Description: Shared or generic administrator IDs are prohibited on FedLine, the core, and the wire room workstation. Each privileged session is logged and reviewed weekly by Information Security.

rows.Control Title: Lockout after failed logons on employee SSO and digital banking admin
rows.Control Description: Employee SSO and the digital-banking administration console lock an ID after five consecutive failed logons. Unlock requires a service desk ticket and manager confirmation.

rows.Control Title: MFA for remote access and privileged core sessions
rows.Control Description: Remote VPN, cloud admin, and any privileged core session require phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication. Emergency break-glass IDs are stored with dual control and logged.

rows.Control Title: Authenticator issuance and reset
rows.Control Description: Hardware tokens and password resets for core and FedLine are issued only after in-person or video identity verification against HR records. Default passwords are changed before the ID is activated.

rows.Control Title: Security and core application logging enabled
rows.Control Description: Logon, privileged commands, and parameter changes on the core, Active Directory, and firewalls are logged and retained for 18 months. Logging cannot be disabled without a change ticket.

rows.Control Title: Weekly SIEM review of privileged and failed-access events
rows.Control Description: Information Security reviews the SIEM dashboard of privileged use and failed access each week, documents the review, and opens an incident ticket for unexplained activity within one business day.

rows.Control Title: Production changes to core and interfaces require a ticket
rows.Control Description: Every production change to the core, ACH/wire interfaces, and general ledger feed requires a change ticket, test evidence, and approval by IT Operations and the application owner before migration. Emergency changes are retro-approved within two business days.

rows.Control Title: Hardening baselines for servers that host the core
rows.Control Description: Servers that host the core and its database are built from a documented hardening baseline. Deviations are tracked as exceptions with an expiration date and compensating control.

rows.Control Title: Baseline inventory of in-scope SOX applications
rows.Control Description: The SOX PMO maintains an inventory of in-scope applications, data flows, and owners. Additions and retirements are approved in the quarterly scoping meeting.

rows.Control Title: Contingency plan for core deposit processing
rows.Control Description: The bank maintains a documented contingency plan covering core deposit processing, ATM/debit authorization, and FedLine. Recovery time for deposit posting is 4 hours; recovery point is the last successful batch.

rows.Control Title: Annual disaster-recovery test of core processing
rows.Control Description: IT Operations and Business Continuity run an annual disaster-recovery test that fails the core to the alternate site, posts a sample deposit file, and records actual recovery time against the 4-hour objective. Exceptions are logged as issues.

rows.Control Title: Nightly backup of core and general ledger
rows.Control Description: Nightly backups of the core database and the general ledger are completed, verified by a restore-sample monthly, and stored offsite. Failed backups page IT Operations before 7 a.m.

rows.Control Title: Computer-room badge access and visitor log
rows.Control Description: The computer room is restricted by badge. Access lists are recertified quarterly by Facilities and IT Operations. Visitors are escorted and logged. Terminated employees' badges are collected the last day.

rows.Control Title: Malware and IDS alerting on bank workstations and servers
rows.Control Description: Endpoint malware protection and network IDS cover all bank workstations and servers. Alerts are triaged by Information Security within four hours during business days.

rows.Control Title: Quarterly vulnerability scanning of in-scope infrastructure
rows.Control Description: In-scope servers and network devices are scanned at least quarterly. Critical findings are patched or formally accepted within 30 days; high findings within 90 days.

rows.Control Title: Encryption in transit for ACH, wire, and core-processor files
rows.Control Description: ACH, wire, and core-processor files leaving the bank are encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2 or higher). Plaintext FTP is prohibited.

rows.Control Title: Encryption at rest for core database backups
rows.Control Description: Core database backups are encrypted at rest with keys held in the bank's key-management process, split from the backup operators.

rows.Control Title: Oversight of the core processor and material fintechs
rows.Control Description: Vendor Management reviews SOC reports, financials, and concentration risk for the core processor and material fintechs at least annually, with findings reported to the steering committee.

rows.Control Title: Security incident handling and regulatory notification
rows.Control Description: Confirmed security incidents are handled under the incident plan. Notification to the primary federal regulator and, when required, to customers follows the bank's incident-notification matrix.

rows.Control Title: Same-day collection of tokens and badges on termination
rows.Control Description: On an employee's last day, HR notifies IT Operations and Facilities. Hardware tokens, VPN certificates, and badges are collected or revoked the same day, and a termination checklist is filed.
